name: Tomato
sensitivity_notes: Chilling sensitive below 7°C; moderate ethylene producer; prone to mould in condensation

name: Fresh Leafy Greens (Spinach)
sensitivity_notes: Rapid moisture loss; very high respiration; requires micro-perforations to prevent anaerobic spoilage

name: Biscuits & Cookies
sensitivity_notes: Extremely sensitive to moisture uptake (loss of crispness) and fat oxidation (rancidity)

name: Potato Chips / Crisps
sensitivity_notes: High fat content requires excellent oxygen and light barrier; nitrogen flushing standard

name: Apple (Fresh Cut Slices)
sensitivity_notes: Prone to enzymatic browning; needs controlled O2 and acidic preservation

name: Fresh Chicken Breast
sensitivity_notes: High moisture and protein; requires high-barrier MAP or vacuum skin packaging to prevent bacterial growth

name: Artisan Sliced Bread
sensitivity_notes: Starch retrogradation (staling) and mould growth; needs balanced barrier and antimould atmosphere

name: Strawberries
sensitivity_notes: High mould risk (Botrytis cinerea); benefits from high CO2 (10-15%) and breathable film

name: Whole Milk Powder
column16: and moisture caking; needs foil/metallized laminate

name: Fresh Mushroom (Button)
sensitivity_notes: Very high respiration rate; open cap discolouration; high OTR required to avoid anaerobic odour

name: Roasted Coffee Beans
sensitivity_notes: Degassing of CO2 after roasting; extreme light and moisture sensitivity; requires one-way degassing valve

name: Fish Fillet (Salmon)
sensitivity_notes: High polyunsaturated fatty acids prone to rapid oxidation; strict cold chain and MAP required

name: Table Grapes
sensitivity_notes: Sensitive to sulphur dioxide generators; needs puncture resistance and condensation control

name: Cheddar Cheese Block
sensitivity_notes: Vacuum or MAP packed with low oxygen permeability to inhibit surface mould while allowing curing
